name: GBIF
tagline: Global biodiversity occurrence, species, and checklist data API
description: GBIF (Global Biodiversity Information Facility) provides free open access to species occurrence records, taxonomic checklists, and related biodiversity data from museums, surveys, and citizen science worldwide. The REST API at api.gbif.org supports search and download of occurrences, species, datasets, and publishers for research, conservation, and applications.

auth.details: Most read endpoints are public with no auth. Authenticated downloads and registry write operations use basic auth with a free GBIF.org account.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public API; no paid plans. Fair-use rate limiting applies.

rate_limits: not published (fair use; heavy users should use bulk downloads)
use_cases: match a scientific or common name to a GBIF taxon key
search species occurrence records by taxon, country, or coordinates
look up taxonomy hierarchy for a species
list datasets or publishers contributing biodiversity data
download large occurrence datasets for offline analysis
